channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Kuester | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Kuester from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tayshaun Prince on John Kuester
item.description:
“Not just going on when Kuester was the coach, but what was going on when everybody was our coach.”

Tayshaun Prince on John Kuester, Mar 6, 2012. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on John Kuester
item.description:
But more frequently he has contributed both scoring and rebounding, including a 25-point, 11 rebound effort in a game against Washington on Sunday.

“It's just feeling comfortable, knowing the system and what coach (John Kuester) wants of me,”

Charlie Villanueva on John Kuester, Nov 27, 2010. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Greg Monroe on John Kuester
item.description:
“I'm just trying to go out there and do things on the floor and do what (Coach John Kuester) asks me to do, but as a team we got to do better.”

Greg Monroe on John Kuester, Nov 26, 2010. Source: Detroit Free Press.
